_meta.instructions:
TWO WAYS TO POPULATE THIS FILE:

  (A) MANUAL · fastest activation, no API key needed
      Open https://business.google.com or search 'BIPE Phoolpur' on Google Maps,
      copy your rating + total review count, paste 3-7 best 5-star reviews below,
      commit. Schema + carousel activate on next deploy.

  (B) AUTOMATED · daily refresh via Google Places API
      Set GOOGLE_PLACES_API_KEY and GOOGLE_PLACES_PLACE_ID as GitHub repo secrets,
      then either run scripts/fetch-google-reviews.mjs locally or wait for the
      daily GitHub Action (.github/workflows/refresh-reviews.yml) to overwrite
      this file automatically.

  Either path works. Pick one; you can switch later.
